common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Lost Keep 2D orthographic game sprite atlas. The first reference is mockup X, definitive masonry finish and palette; second is supporting palette only. Match X's crisp hand-clustered pixel technique and old lived-in carved masonry, not the purple forest stone from older art. Pale BLUE-GREY chunky square blocks #8C93AA #6E7590 #4E5470, mortar #2A2C40, void heart #0B0812. FOUR flat tones per material, deliberate pixel clusters, thin dark sel-out only at silhouette. Carved pale cap tiles have a recessed dark groove. Moss olive-green, hanging ivy; crystal heaps are faceted square pink-violet masonry blocks #B07AA8 to #6A4A78; flowers #9B6AD0 on dark leaves. Roots only muted dull brick/brown red, never saturated crimson or magenta; this is a specific exception for this shrine region. Amber flame #F2B04A with #FFE59A core, flame only, NO halo/glow/bloom or light cast on background. Strict flat SIDE ELEVATION, no perspective, top faces, tilt or vanishing points. No scene, UI, lettering, swatches, borders, numbers, watermarks or living characters. Each object separated by genuine transparent alpha unless explicitly opaque backdrop. Solid masses are fully opaque black at heart, not transparent:192px lit edge blocks with no holes, next96px darken in block-shaped steps to void along block outlines, never a straight light/shadow boundary. Natural varied worn edges, repairs, ivy in cracks; not pristine symmetry except required flat walking lines. PIXEL SCALE8: compose at native canvas divided by8 then enlarge NEAREST NEIGHBOR exactly8, every art pixel is8x8 one flat colour aligned top-left. No antialias, blur, smooth shading or subpixel detail.

prompts.SH1: Canvas3072x1024 (native384x128). TWO full-width horizontal masonry strips, seamless horizontal repeats, no margin left/right. FLOOR band y0..448: absolutely straight walking edge at y64; small moss tufts and tiny purple flowers rise above it, carved pale cap row with dark groove. Below y64 show192px fully lit square chunky blocks64..96px each in2-3 rows then96px block-shaped fade into solid VOID to y448. NOT floating island silhouette; back of solid floor at bottom of band is full width opaque void. Leave y448..576 fully TRANSPARENT. CEILING band y576..1024: full-width opaque void at top y576; block-shaped shadows step down into same pale lit masonry rim toward underside guide y960. Loose underside blocks, short ivy and thin dull brick roots hang below960 to1024 maximum. No cap grass floor on this underside. Both bands horizontally tile seamlessly, matching blocks/mortar and vegetation over the seam. No crystals, flames or props needed.

At centre a stepped plinth and640px tall carved HOODED STONE STATUE with hands holding small pale orb, integrated statue not a person. Two smaller hooded stone statues in niches either side. Behind these two crescent-moon stone arches, broken columns. Two low braziers with isolated amber flames, no halos. Pink-violet square crystal heaps, purple flowers and ivy flank plinth. Thick carved pale blue-grey slab below walking line, a single ROUND front medallion; stepped square masonry underside tapering to a point with ivy and thin muted brick roots, depth1.5..2 times slab depth. Everything fits canvas with generous transparent margins. Image should show whole shrine island, no cropped structures. Use exclusively pale blue-grey stone, not purple.
